name: blockingmachine-monorepo
description: High-performance adblock compiler, DNS rule deduplicator, and AI-powered network defense suite for Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, and modern desktops.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@blockingmachine/core --workspace=@blockingmachine/https-filter --workspace=@blockingmachine/system-daemon && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/patch-image-size.cjs && node scripts/patch-cross-zip.cjs && node scripts/patch-react-native-rn087.cjs && node scripts/patch-expo-plist-xmldom.cjs
scripts.ai:train: cd packages/ai-training && .venv/bin/python train.py --features 3 --observations observations-2026-09-29.db --live-observations live_observations.db --out model_artifacts_v4
scripts.ai:export: cd packages/ai-training && .venv/bin/python evaluate.py --artifacts model_artifacts_v4 --features 3 --observations observations-2026-09-29.db --live-observations live_observations.db && .venv/bin/python export.py --artifacts model_artifacts_v4 --features 3 --observations observations-2026-09-29.db --live-observations live_observations.db --out model_v4_experimental.json
scripts.ai:gate: cd packages/ai-training && .venv/bin/python gate.py --artifacts model_artifacts_v4 --export model_v4_experimental.json --allowlist model_artifacts_v4/allowlist.json --shadow "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Blockingmachine/learned-shadow.jsonl" --reviews reviewed.csv --baseline drift_baseline_v4.json --observations observations-2026-09-29.db --live-observations live_observations.db --out gate_report_v4.json
scripts.ai:cycle: npm run ai:ingest && npm run ai:train && npm run ai:export && npm run ai:anatomy && npm run ai:gate
